Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.Tools
ChangelogMessages: Removed the hidden dependency on the native `zip` utility (and the vendored `build-lambda-zip.exe`) when creating deployment bundles. Bundles are now created with the built-in .NET compression libraries and marked with Unix file permissions so custom runtime files such as `bootstrap` remain executable on AWS Lambda. This fixes `deploy-function`, `package`, and `deploy-serverless` failing with `Failed to find the "zip" utility program in path` on minimal Linux environments such as the bare .NET SDK container images.
